name: Beriah
bio: Beriah was born to Ephraim after Ephraim's sons Ezer and Elead were killed by the men of Gath and Ephraim had mourned many days. Ephraim named him Beriah, meaning "in trouble," because tragedy had struck his household (1 Chronicles 7:21-23). Beriah's daughter Sherah built the towns of Lower and Upper Beth Horon and Uzzen Sherah (1 Chronicles 7:24).
